title: Purchase Of The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury By The Soviet Authorities

page_data.en:
Form No. 3
G. 25,000-1-34

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch.
REPORT
Date... July 28 / 1934.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5798
Date 28 / 7 / 34）

Subject (in full) Purchase of the Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury
by the Soviet Authorities.

Made by F.S. Makaroff Forwarded by （签名）

Regarding the proposed sale of the Shanghai Evening
Post & Mercury to the Soviet Authorities, further enquiries
reveal that all negotiations terminated following the sudden
demise of Victor Volinsky, who was in charge of the Press
and Information Bureaux of the Soviet Embassy in China.
Volinsky, who died on April 9, 1934 in the General
Hospital, arrived in Shanghai from Moscow on March 13, 1934
having been invested with full authority to conduct the
necessary transactions for the buying of the above mentioned
newspaper.
Being new to Shanghai and having no knowledge of
local conditions, Volinsky was assisted in his work by
S.I. Slepak, representative of "Tass" News Agency in North
China, who is reported to have left by rail for Peiping in
June, 1934.

（签名）
F. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：A J
28/7/34.）
（批： illegible signature）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S.2，特别科。
报告
日期……1934年7月28日。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案编号 S. B. REGISTRY.
编号 D 5798
日期 34/7/28）

事由（全称）苏联当局收购《上海晚邮报与信使报》（Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury）。

制作人 F.S. Makaroff 转呈人 （签名）

关于拟将《上海晚邮报与信使报》出售给苏联当局一事，进一步查询显示，所有谈判均因维克多·沃林斯基（Victor Volinsky）的突然去世而终止。沃林斯基负责苏联驻华大使馆的新闻与信息局事务。沃林斯基于1934年4月9日在广慈医院（General Hospital）去世，他于1934年3月13日从莫斯科抵达上海，被赋予全权处理购买上述报纸所需的交易事宜。

由于初到上海且不了解当地情况，沃林斯基在工作中得到了“塔斯社”（Tass）华北代表S.I. 斯列帕克（S.I. Slepak）的协助。据报，斯列帕克已于1934年6月乘火车前往北平。

（签名）
F. S.
特别科主管警官。

（批注：A J
34/7/28。）
（批注：无法辨认的签名）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S.B. REGISTRY. Branch Form No. D 5798 Date April 11. 1934. Date 11 / 4 / 34）

Subject (in full)........................................S.I. Slepak (or Slepack) and the purchase
of the Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury.
Made by....D.S. Tcheremshansky................Forwarded by....JBRu. S.

（左侧批注：x See also
Feb. S.O. 9:31）

Semen Ignatievitch Slepak (or Slepack), representative
of "Tass" News Agency in North China, arrived at Shanghai from
Peiping a few days ago by rail. It is reported that Slepak's
mission here is in connection with the negotiations between the
Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, No. 17-21 Avenue Edward VII,
and the Soviet Authorities regarding the purchase of this news-
paper by the latter. It is said that the Soviet Authorities
propose to finance this newspaper in order to change its policy
to that of a pro-Soviet nature. The proprietors of the news-
paper are prepared to sell provided the sum demanded is forth-
coming.

Slepak's place of residence is at present unknown.

（左侧批注：S2
Further report
in due course
JBR）

D.S. Tcheremshansky
G. Tcheremshansky
D. S.
JBR 12/4.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
Copies sent to Messrs Liphin, Kibson and Vandenberg.
ZB Yoo
11/4

S.2，特别科
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 C. & S.B. REGISTRY. 分支表格编号 D 5798 日期 1934年4月11日。日期 34/4/11）

事由（全称）........................................S.I. 斯列帕克（或 Slepack）与收购《上海晚邮报与信使报》。
制作人....D.S. Tcheremshansky................转呈人....JBRu. S.

（左侧批注：x 另见
二月 S.O. 9:31）

谢苗·伊格纳季耶维奇·斯列帕克（Semen Ignatievitch Slepak，或 Slepack），“塔斯社”（Tass）华北代表，数日前乘火车从北平抵达上海。据报，斯列帕克此行的任务与位于爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）17-21号的《上海晚邮报与信使报》同苏联当局之间就后者收购该报进行的谈判有关。据说苏联当局打算为该报提供资金，以将其方针转变为亲苏性质。该报业主表示，只要所要求的款项到位，便准备出售。

斯列帕克目前的住址不详。

（左侧批注：S2
适时提交
进一步报告
JBR）

D.S. Tcheremshansky
G. Tcheremshansky
D. S.
JBR 4/12。

特别科主管警官。
副本已发送给 Liphin、Kibson 和 Vandenberg 先生。
ZB Yoo
4/11
